description: The done-gate in the agent loop (plan task pod-23, docs/PROOF-GATE.md): where AgentRunner asks it and what it does with the judgment (the host message, the notice, the outcome, the receipts, the stall counters, a tree that changed afterwards, the owner's acceptance), and the report on the changes to the checks (lib/agent.mjs, lib/proof/gate.mjs). The rules of the gate are in proof-gate.json, where it runs and what interrupts it in proof-gate-places.json. Each mutation runs the whole suite (about 40 s).

mutations.name: GA-no-begin
mutations.what: the gate never begins

patches.old: context.gate = await this.doneGate.begin({ task, directory: this.#directory(task.id), signal: context.controller.signal, emit: this.#gateEvent(task) });

mutations.name: GA-not-sent-back
mutations.what: a failed round does not send the agent back

mutations.name: GA-no-message
mutations.what: the agent is sent back without the host message

patches.old: context.history.appendUser([{ type: 'input_text', text: this.#redact(gated.feedback) }], { kind: GATE_EVENT });

mutations.name: GA-hooks-ungated
mutations.what: the hooks judge the answer without the gate

patches.old: assess: () => ({ verification: gateVerification(assessCompletionEvidence(task.goalPlan, task.progress), gated.result), completion: gateCompletion(classifyTaskCompletion(task.goalPlan, task.progress), gated.result) }),
patches.new: assess: () => ({ verification: assessCompletionEvidence(task.goalPlan, task.progress), completion: classifyTaskCompletion(task.goalPlan, task.progress) }),

mutations.name: GA-no-notice
mutations.what: the answer carries no notice

patches.old: const parts = { words: answer, gateNotice: gateNotice(gated.result), verificationNotice: null,
patches.new: const parts = { words: answer, gateNotice: null, verificationNotice: null,
